meta.subject: fixed afu cci write bug, fixed profile cache write miss bug, fixed bram byteenable inferance

en.summary: This is a mixed hardware bug-fix commit. The clearest reusable reinjection target is the cache data-store byte-enable path: the patch changes the cache RAM path to perform true per-byte writes instead of overwriting wider chunks, while the same commit also repairs AFU-side CCI write accounting.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes hardware bug fixes, including BRAM byte-enable behavior.
The cache-side patch changes central data-store RTL and the generic dual-port RAM primitive, not tests or host software.
The modified logic directly determines whether partial writes preserve untouched bytes in a cache line.
disqualifiers: The commit is mixed and also touches AFU control logic, utility modules, an FPU file, and synthesis collateral.
Multiple real fixes exist in the same patch, so the fault plan focuses on the byte-enable bug as the clearest portable case.
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_data_store.v changes the data RAM instantiation to use BYTEENW=CACHE_LINE_SIZE and connects byteen(byte_enable) instead of byteen(1'b1).
hw/rtl/libs/VX_dp_ram.v replaces grouped 32-bit write loops with per-byte update loops when BYTEENW > 1.
hw/rtl/cache/VX_data_access.v now builds write_data from writeword_in and byte_enable, while the read-during-write merge remains in the output hazard path.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A cache data array that supports sub-word or partial-line stores must propagate byte-enable information all the way into the physical RAM write path. If the array write is collapsed to a full-word or full-line update, or if the RAM primitive honors enables at a coarser granularity than the requested store mask, untouched bytes are overwritten with stale or unintended data. This is a classic portable partial-write corruption bug.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A store or write-miss update modifies only some bytes of a cache word or line while other bytes must be preserved.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Widen the effective write-enable granularity so the data array updates more bytes than the architectural store mask intended.
portability_notes: Apply this to any cache, scratchpad, or profile/store array that supports byte or lane masks.
The bug can be injected either at the RAM instantiation boundary or inside the generic RAM primitive that implements masked writes.
The AFU CCI write-accounting fix in the same commit is real, but the byte-enable bug is the more direct cross-DUT injection pattern.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the data-array write interface that should accept a byte mask or lane mask for partial stores.
Replace the per-byte enable with a scalar or wider-granularity enable, or group several byte lanes under one enable bit.
Keep the store-data path unchanged so masked stores now overwrite neighboring bytes with whatever data are present on the wider write bus.
Exercise partial stores or write-miss updates that should preserve untouched bytes and compare resulting line contents.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache data-store byte-enable propagation into the backing RAM
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes VX_data_store.v to pass byte_enable into VX_dp_ram with BYTEENW=CACHE_LINE_SIZE, and it changes VX_dp_ram.v so masked writes update memory byte-by-byte instead of in grouped 32-bit chunks.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_data_store.v, the RAM instance changed from byteen(1'b1) to byteen(byte_enable). In VX_dp_ram.v, the masked write loops changed from nested 32-bit groups to one loop over every byte enable bit.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Partial cache-line writes will overwrite bytes that should remain unchanged, causing silent data corruption on masked stores or write-miss updates.
evidence_for_injection: The patch explicitly wires byte_enable into the cache RAM instance, which shows the prior path ignored fine-grain masking at the storage boundary.
VX_dp_ram.v changed the actual memory-array update loops, so the fix is not cosmetic inference tuning only; it changes write semantics.
The commit subject explicitly mentions BRAM byte-enable behavior, matching the storage bug mechanism.
notes: The AFU CCI write bug fixed in the same commit is also real, but the cache byte-enable bug is the cleaner reusable mutation.
A minimal reinjection can stop at the RAM-mask path without reverting the unrelated AFU-side changes.

zh.summary: 这是一个混合硬件 bug-fix 提交。最清晰、最可复用的回注目标是 cache 数据存储的 byte-enable 路径：补丁让 cache RAM 真正按字节写入，而不是按更宽粒度覆盖；同一提交也顺带修复了 AFU 侧 CCI 写记账问题。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确写明了硬件 bug 修复，其中包括 BRAM byte-enable 行为。
cache 侧补丁修改的是核心 data-store RTL 和通用双口 RAM 原语，而不是测试或主机软件。
被修改逻辑直接决定部分写入是否会保留 cache line 中未被修改的字节。
disqualifiers: 该提交是混合提交，也修改了 AFU 控制逻辑、工具模块、一个 FPU 文件和综合脚本。
同一补丁中包含多个真实修复，因此 fault plan 聚焦于 byte-enable bug 这一最清晰的可移植场景。
evidence: hw/rtl/cache/VX_data_store.v 把数据 RAM 实例改成 BYTEENW=CACHE_LINE_SIZE，并连接 byteen(byte_enable)，不再是 byteen(1'b1)。
hw/rtl/libs/VX_dp_ram.v 在 BYTEENW > 1 时，把按 32 位分组的写循环改成逐字节更新。
hw/rtl/cache/VX_data_access.v 现在根据 writeword_in 和 byte_enable 构造 write_data，而读写同址合并逻辑保留在输出 hazard 路径。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 支持子字写入或部分 cache line 写入的数据阵列，必须把 byte-enable 信息一路传到物理 RAM 写路径。如果阵列写入被收窄成整字或整行更新，或者 RAM 原语实际只按更粗粒度响应使能，那么本应保持不变的字节就会被旧数据或无关数据覆盖。这是很典型、很可移植的部分写入损坏 bug。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache line 部分写入掩码传播
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一次 store 或 write-miss 更新只修改 cache 字或 cache line 中的部分字节，其余字节必须保留。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 扩大实际生效的写掩码粒度，让数据阵列写入的字节数多于体系结构 store mask 所要求的范围。
portability_notes: 适用于任何支持字节掩码或 lane 掩码的 cache、scratchpad 或 profile/store 阵列。
该故障可以注入在 RAM 实例边界，也可以注入在实现 masked write 的通用 RAM 原语内部。
同一提交中的 AFU CCI 写记账修复也是真实 bug，但 byte-enable 错误更适合作为跨 DUT 的通用注入模式。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到本应接受 byte mask 或 lane mask 的数据阵列写接口。
把逐字节使能替换成单比特或更粗粒度的使能，或让多个 byte lane 共享同一个 enable 位。
保持 store 数据路径不变，使带 mask 的 store 现在会用宽写总线上的数据覆盖相邻字节。
执行本应保留未修改字节的部分写入或 write-miss 更新，并对比最终 line 内容。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache data-store 到底层 RAM 的 byte-enable 传播路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复让 VX_data_store.v 把 byte_enable 传入 VX_dp_ram，并在 VX_dp_ram.v 中把 masked write 从按 32 位组更新改成逐字节更新。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_data_store.v 中，RAM 实例从 byteen(1'b1) 改成了 byteen(byte_enable)。在 VX_dp_ram.v 中，masked write 循环从嵌套 32 位组改成了对每一个 byte-enable 位逐个更新。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 部分 cache-line 写入会覆盖本应保持不变的字节，导致 masked store 或 write-miss 更新出现静默数据损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁明确把 byte_enable 接到了 cache RAM 实例上，这说明旧路径在存储边界处忽略了细粒度掩码。
VX_dp_ram.v 改动了实际 memory array 的更新循环，因此这不是纯综合推断调优，而是写语义修复。
提交标题直接提到了 BRAM byte-enable 问题，与该存储 bug 机制完全一致。
notes: 同一提交中修复的 AFU CCI write bug 也是真实 bug，但 cache byte-enable 错误更适合作为可复用变异。
最小回注只需停留在 RAM 掩码路径，无需回退无关的 AFU 侧改动。
